messages:
Asha (CS): Heads-up: AcornHealth submitted a request to onboard a clinical-notes summarizer. They require private deployment (VPC/on-prem) + HSM-managed keys, strict no-persistent-user-logs, and a passed safety eval before renewal. Renewal ~6w out — high risk if delayed. Who can own timeline?
Liam (Infra): Private + HSM doable. Need a ticket for VPC peering, KMS creds, and the HSM vendor (which model). Also clarify GPU profile — they mentioned a 7B quantized variant. Any latency SLO?
Devon (ML): We can run safety and regression evals. Request anonymized sample notes and expected summary length distribution. Also need a small holdout with PHI examples redacted so we can verify redaction works.
Renee (PM): Note infra team is tight this sprint. Is there an MVP path (e.g., dedicated-hosted in a customer VPC) that meets "no egress"? Customer insists on data residency.
Asha (CS): They require zero-evidence of telemetry to third parties. Private/VPC only. They want a canary within 2 weeks of artifact handoff.
Onboard Bot: New onboarding created · CS-7981 · Asha (CS)
Liam (Infra): If ML delivers a compiled artifact + quant profile by EOD Fri we can aim for a 2-week canary. Need artifact transfer method: S3 presigned or customer bundle. HSM vendor details? (they use Thales).
Devon (ML): Proposed eval plan: safety/regression on ~5k prompt/target pairs, hallucination threshold <2% (domain-specific), PHI redaction tests, perf targets p50 <250ms for 512-token context. I'll stand up the eval harness. Can we get the prompt suite?
Asha (CS): I'll collect a sanitized prompt set and coordinate with legal for a signed assurance on redaction. Scheduling enablement with their ML infra lead Wed 10:00 PT.
Renee (PM): Flagging renewal owner Susan (AM) — if canary misses SLA, escalate to exec sponsor. I'll update CRM with "at-risk" tag.
Devon (ML): For PHI checks we'll run both heuristic regex tests and a model-based detector. Example redaction config I plan to use:
```yaml
redaction:
  enabled: true
  patterns:
    - ssn
    - medical_record_number
  strategy: deterministic-mask
  audit_mode: false
```
Liam (Infra): Also need a privacy-preserving logging policy. Recommend: disable raw input persistence, only emit aggregated perf metrics and error counters. I'll draft ops PR.
Asha (CS): Action items:
- Asha: collect prompt set + confirm HSM contact + get signed no-logging clause
- Devon: finalize eval plan + pass/fail criteria + run first pass on sample
- Liam: open infra ticket for VPC/HSM + draft log policy
- Renee: update CRM renewal risk + coordinate enablement schedule
I'll send a brief to Susan after enablement.
Devon (ML): One more rec: model variant = gpt-7b-q4_0 (quantized) with tuned KV-cache params. Will validate quality/latency tradeoffs on our bench.
Renee (PM): If we get eval green by next Tue we can schedule the canary before renewal.
Onboard Bot: Reminder scheduled · Enablement session Wed 10:00 PT · CS-7981
Asha (CS): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Liam (Infra): Opening infra ticket CS-7981-IR now and assigning @Devon
Devon (ML): Got it, will prioritize the eval runs and post preliminary results here.
Renee (PM): Copy — I'll prepare the renewal note and include the risk mitigation plan.
